_comment: CHRON canonical event store. Dates only — day counts are COMPUTED at render. Add an event with a real source or do not add it.
_prediction_schema: Falsifiable predictions: each event carries predictions[] with claim, expected_value, threshold, verifier (how to check), falsifier (what proves it wrong). A prediction that can only be 'did event happen' is not a prediction.

events.title: F-A IRFAN falsification target: individually-SEAL-clean action-class repeated N times normalizes extraction (trajectory failure, per-act passes F1-F13); review-harness detects >=1 such trajectory by target_date
events.note: PREDICATE: action-class A repeated N>=30 decisions, each passes F1-F13+Witness+Amanah+SEAL individually, yet aggregate shows extraction drift (who-paid asymmetry / recurrence normalization). DETECTED-BY: CHRON review-question ('what becomes normal if repeated?') + verify/lesson loop. FALSIFIER (=> IRFAN demoted redundant): (i) zero such trajectories in window, OR (ii) existing machinery (Reality-Graph RG-6 / scar / CHRON-lesson) catches it FIRST. PROMOTION RULE (Path-B, verbatim): repeated catches passing F1-F13+Witness+Amanah+SEAL => primitive candidate. Sealed refs: thesis 80378697, map 31b8066e, harness spec receipt e-0729e64f. claim_state=HYPOTHESIS (TENTATIVE).

events.title: F-B IRFAN falsification target: Authority-Envelope-passing action where a narrower alternative sufficed — CanMutate = A AND S AND T AND B has NO Necessity term; review-harness detects >=1 such case by target_date
events.note: PREDICATE: envelope passes (AuthorityGranted AND ScopeMatches AND TargetPermitted AND BoundaryActive) AND a strictly narrower alternative existed AND no current floor measures necessity (code-level OBS: no necessity/minimum-power term in the formula; least-power doctrine = invariant+skill at ROUTING only). DETECTED-BY: review question 'why the cannon when the needle works?' (CONCERN-class advisory per governance/IRFAN-REVIEW-SCHEMA-v1 C1-C3; review NEVER blocks — anti-de-facto-floor rule). FALSIFIER (=> redundant): zero such cases across >=30 envelope-passing actions in window, OR an existing mechanism flags them first. PROMOTION RULE: repeated passing-failures catches => primitive candidate. Note: runtime plan-comparison detector = Phase-1 code cycle, SEPARATELY ordered (not yet authorized); this event tracks the temporal commitment. claim_state=HYPOTHESIS (TENTATIVE). Sealed refs: thesis 80378697, map 31b8066e, receipt e-0729e64f.

_human_field: Optional `human`: the BM rendering of a prediction's machine claim, for surfaces read by humans. The machine `claim` stays canonical for verification; a surface that has no `human` rendering stays silent rather than printing the machine text.
